description: This file defines a function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of records containing agent-related cost data, and transforms it into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It handles categorization, zero-filling categories across agents, and sorting options.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, organizing data by agents and categories, filling gaps with zeros, and applying sorting options.
